articles.summary: Il sottosegretario alla Presidenza del Consiglio è intervenuto ad un incontro sul tema delle dipendenze al festival delle Regioni a Firenze

articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
articles.summary: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.

articles.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
articles.summary: SpaceX has locked in a binding commitment for roughly $40 billion in financing to pay for AI chips and related data center equipment, the company disclosed in a regulatory filing Monday. In a statement, SpaceX called it the “largest committed GPU financing” ever.

articles.title: Londra, la via dello shopping Oxford Street diventa pedonale
articles.summary: LONDRA - Da oggi metà di Oxford Street, la via dello shopping più affollata d’Europa, frequentata da 500mila persone ogni giorno, diventa pedonale. Dopo anni di proteste, rinvii e polemiche...
